headline: Xbox prices jump up to €200 or £170 in EU and UK
summary: Microsoft's console sees its third price hike since May 2025, with the Series S now over 43% more expensive.
details: Microsoft has announced significant price increases for its Xbox consoles in the European Union and the United Kingdom. The 1TB Xbox Series X with a disc drive is now priced at €799.99 / £669.99, up from €599.99 / £499.99.

The 512GB Xbox Series S has also seen a substantial jump, now costing €499.99 / £429.99, an increase of over 43% from its previous price of €349.99 / £299.99. This marks the third round of price increases for Xbox consoles since May 2025.

These price hikes are attributed to rising component costs, particularly RAM and storage, driven by demand from the AI industry. The 2TB model of the Xbox Series X is also being retired due to these storage constraints.

The 1TB Xbox Series S now costs €599.99 / £519.99, and the 1TB Xbox Series X Digital Edition is priced at €749.99 / £619.99. These increases make the consoles significantly more expensive than their original launch prices.

headline_marked: Apple's [[camera-equipped AirPods]] could launch as soon as next month
headline: Apple's camera-equipped AirPods could launch as soon as next month
summary: Rumors suggest Apple is developing AirPods with integrated cameras, potentially for augmented reality features, with a possible release next month.
details: Apple has reportedly been working on AirPods equipped with cameras for an extended period. These new earbuds are expected to focus on augmented reality (AR) capabilities, leveraging Visual Intelligence technology.
While details remain scarce, the integration of cameras could enable new AR experiences, allowing users to interact with digital content overlaid on their real-world view.
The original report from 9to5Mac suggests that these camera-equipped AirPods might be unveiled as early as next month. This would place their debut ahead of Apple's typical fall product cycle.
The development of such a product aligns with Apple's ongoing interest in AR and mixed reality, as evidenced by their previous patents and rumored headset devices.
